title: Airgapped Site Handoff Notes — SFO Customer
content:
Notes to self / quick handoff for the SFO air-gapped site (customer call tomorrow 09:00 PST). Mostly a brain dump: preflight findings, remaining blockers, urgent TODOs, and context for whoever picks this up.

Customer: SFO Health — strict airgap, internal mirror only, HSM-backed KMS preferred but they said 'can start with cloud KMS in staging'.
Deployment target: k8s 1.24 (RKE2), 6 nodes (3 control, 3 workers), 2x A100 per worker, local NVMe for /var/lib/containers.
Primary contact: Jordan Lee (infrastructure) — jordan.lee@sfohealth.local (note: internal mail only).

Preflight summary (done):
- Inventory confirmed: 6 nodes reachable via management network (10.10.2.0/24). Hostnames, MACs in the spreadsheet on Confluence.
- Disks: 3x 3.8TB NVMe per worker, mounted to /mnt/nvme0, /mnt/nvme1, /mnt/nvme2. Need to finalize LVM layout.
- GPUs: NVIDIA A100, drivers reported 525.89 on two nodes, 520.x on one node (inconsistent).
- Kernel: 5.15.x across all nodes — need to patch to 5.15.49 on node02.
- Firewall: edge firewall blocks outbound to docker.io and ghcr; required for mirroring.
- Time: NTP not yet configured on the cluster control plane (major blocker for cert rotation).

Immediate blockers (action = who):
- GPU driver parity (Raj): update node03 to 525.89 or roll back others to 520.x — customer prefers stable vendor driver. ACTION: schedule maintenance window with Jordan.
- CA cert for internal registry not present on nodes (MUST add to /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors). ACTION: Sofia to deliver cert bundle to on-site admin, include instructions for update-ca-trust.
- NTP: control-plane drift >120s on node01. ACTION: I (Maya) will send the NTP config snippet and ask Jordan to enable chronyd on all masters.
- Registry mirror sync script failing due to proxy auth (401). ACTION: Need creds from network team (JIRA-PD-1087) — Raj to follow up.

Checklist (for next engineer running through installers):
- [ ] Confirm maintenance window and taint nodes for driver upgrades.
- [ ] Mirror selected container images into customer Artifactory (images list attached in Confluence page ENG-4321).
- [ ] Validate CA chain installed system-wide (openssl s_client against registry on port 8443).
- [ ] Run private-deploy bootstrap (runbook v2) with --offline-mode flag.
- [ ] Confirm KMS/HSM keywrap policy: test encrypt/decrypt with sample key (see HSM-playbook notes).
- [ ] Apply sysctl settings: net.core.somaxconn=1024, vm.max_map_count=262144.
- [ ] Ensure kernel modules: vfio, nvidia-uvm present and loaded at boot.
- [ ] Confirm SELinux mode; recommend permissive during install, enforce later with policy tests.

Commands and snippets I used / recommend:
- Mirror helper (run locally in bastion):
  ./mirror-sync.sh --src-list images.txt --registry https://artifactory.sfo.internal:8443 --auth /tmp/mirror-creds.json

- Check CA chain:
  openssl s_client -connect artifactory.sfo.internal:8443 -showcerts

- Quick GPU check:
  ssh worker01 sudo nvidia-smi --query-gpu=driver_version,name --format=csv

- Run bootstrap (example):
  ./redwood-private-bootstrap --inventory inventory.yml --offline --registry artifactory.sfo.internal:8443 --kms-provider hsm --yes

Notes about KMS/HSM:
- Customer asked about HSM latency impact on token generation; measured latency on their HSM ~12ms/op (from test harness). Need to recommend local caching policy in redwood-private: cache TTL 10s for session tokens.
- HSM integration requires CSR signing by their security team; two-week lead time for production key. For now use staged KMS path.

Security & compliance reminders:
- Bring your own key requirement: final production must use HSM-backed keys. Include attestation doc for them to sign.
- Audit logging: enable forwarding to on-prem ELK (they use Filebeat to internal log collector). Confirm index naming.

Operational details / gotchas I ran into:
- Artifactory returns 403 if user-agent header missing (surprising!). Mirror script needed to set a UA.
- RKE2 had a default of 30s kubelet grace — bumped to 120s for noisy nodes with GPUs.
- Containerd config needed max_concurrent_downloads=10 to avoid timeouts behind proxy.
- If /var/lib/containers on NVMe has fstab entry with nofail, systemd sometimes starts services before mount. Recommend using systemd mount units referencing network-online.target.

Questions outstanding (to resolve before handoff):
- Do they want node-local PVs or use the built-in dynamic CSI? (Jordan: leaning node-local for perf)
- Which registry credentials will we use for initial mirror? (network team promised creds but not delivered)
- Need SOC to approve HSM integration plan — who on our side will own compliance review? (suggest: Sofia takes point)

Quick timeline (my plan):
- Today (03-12): finalize certs and NTP push, request driver window.
- Tomorrow (03-13): driver upgrade + registry mirror run in maintenance window.
- Day after (03-14): bootstrap redwood-private in offline mode, run smoke tests (gen text job, embedding test).

Smoke test checklist after bootstrap:
- [ ] Successful /health endpoints on control plane
- [ ] Run sample inference job (small prompt) — latency < 1200ms cold start on 2048 tokens? (est)
- [ ] Verify KV cache persistence across pod restarts
- [ ] Confirm logs forwarded to ELK and audit events present (token create/delete)

Personal TODO (notes to self):
- Pack the install USB with certs + mirror tarball; label clearly.
- Add step in runbook: verify chronyd and NTP before cert issuance — save a note in Confluence.
- Add a regression test for registry mirror auth header behavior.

Handoff blurb to include in email to Jordan: "Attaching the minimal steps to get us to bootstrap: (1) confirm maintenance window, (2) install CA bundle, (3) enable NTP on masters, (4) provide mirror creds. Once those are green I will kick the offline bootstrap and run smoke tests."

References (internal):
- Confluence: ENG-4321 (install images list & runbook v2)
- Jira: JIRA-PD-1087 (mirror creds)
- Slack: #private-deploys thread abc123 (driver scheduling discussion)

End of scratchpad. Throwaway notes and fragments above — keep as working doc until we close the JIRA-PD-1087 and confirm HSM timeline.

Signature: Maya — will be on-call for handoff tomorrow 08:30 PST if needed.
